pages.image_type: Digital rendering / photo composite of landscape
pages.description: A wide horizontal color photograph depicting a mountainous landscape under a clear blue sky that gradates from darker blue at the top to lighter blue near the horizon. A large mountain ridge with rocky, forested slopes in shades of brown, gray, and dark green dominates the middle and left portions of the image. At the base of the mountains lies a valley containing a spread-out low-rise development of buildings, houses, and structures in white, tan, and gray tones, interspersed with green trees and vegetation. In the foreground is a grassy area with green and yellowish vegetation, a metal guardrail running horizontally across the lower portion, and a paved gray road or surface at the very bottom. Superimposed in the upper-center-right area of the sky is a white, rounded, lens-shaped or pebble-like object with a faceted or cellular textured surface, appearing digitally added and floating above the mountain. No text is visible anywhere in the image.
